Description: Represents the mother's age group at the time of delivery. It is recorded using age intervals or individual age categories, allowing the analysis of maternal age in relation to preterm birth.

Indicates the highest level of educational attainment completed by the mother. Categories range from lower educational levels, such as grade 8 or less, to higher education, including master's and doctoral or professional degrees.

Represents the total number of the mother's previous children who were born alive and are still living at the time of the current delivery. It is a discrete count and does not include the baby in the current pregnancy.

Represents the number of the mother's previous children who were born alive but are no longer living at the time of the current delivery. It excludes stillbirths. The special value 9 requires verification using the original data codebook.
Encoding_Consideration: Verify special value 9 using the official codebook

Description: Represents the mother's Body Mass Index (BMI) before the beginning of the current pregnancy. BMI is a numerical measure calculated from weight and height and is commonly used to describe body weight relative to height.
Encoding_Consideration: Investigate missing values and potential outliers

Description: Indicates whether the mother had diabetes before the beginning of the current pregnancy. It is recorded as a binary categorical variable with two observed categories: Yes and No.
Indicates whether the mother had hypertension before the beginning of the current pregnancy. It helps examine the relationship between pre-existing maternal hypertension and preterm birth.
Indicates whether the mother had experienced at least one preterm birth in a previous pregnancy. It represents the mother's history of preterm delivery before the current pregnancy.
Describes the number of babies in the current pregnancy. It distinguishes singleton pregnancies (one baby), twin pregnancies (two babies), and triplet pregnancies (three babies).
Encoding_Consideration: One-Hot encoding; categories are singleton, twins, triplets

Description: Represents the target variable indicating whether the current delivery occurred before 37 completed weeks of gestation. It is binary: 0 represents a term birth, while 1 represents a preterm birth.
